::: {.module-lead}
**Estimated time:** 8 minutes  
**Guiding question:** Which access method should a new Longleaf user choose?
:::

## Learning goals

By the end of this module, participants should be able to:

- identify the steps required to request an account;
- compare terminal, browser, and file-transfer access; and
- select an appropriate method for a common task.

## Ways to connect

| Method | Best for | What the user sees |
|---|---|---|
| Terminal connection | Direct command-line work | A shell prompt on a login node |
| Web portal | Browser-based interactive work | Files, applications, and interactive sessions |
| SFTP client | Moving files between systems | A graphical local-and-remote file browser |

## Moving files

Introduce a graphical SFTP workflow first, then note when command-line tools are useful for larger or repeatable transfers.

## Demonstration sequence

1. Open the chosen access method.
2. Connect and identify the login environment.
3. Locate the home and project directories.
4. Transfer one small example file.
